name: geocode_address
title: Geocode a French address
description: Resolve a French address, street, or city to normalized candidates with coordinates, INSEE city code and BAN id (Base Adresse Nationale). Use this first if an address is ambiguous.

query.description: Free-form address, e.g. '10 rue de la Paix Paris'

citycode.description: INSEE code, arrondissement level in Paris/Lyon/Marseille

name: property_sales
title: Real property sales around an address (DVF)
description: List actual notarized property sales (price, date, surface, rooms) recorded by the French tax administration (DVF) around an address, or for a whole commune if only a city is given. Data 2021-2025, no API key.

address.description: Address, street or city in France

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters around the address (default 300; ignored for city-wide queries)

years.description: DVF years to include (2021-2025). Defaults to all.

price_per_m2.description: Set only when the deed covers exactly one dwelling

name: price_per_m2
title: Price per m² statistics (DVF)
description: Compute price-per-m² statistics (median, mean, quartiles, per-year evolution) from actual notarized sales around a French address or across a commune. Data 2021-2025.

address.description: Address, street or city in France

years.description: DVF years to include (2021-2025). Defaults to all.

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters around the address (default 500; ignored for city-wide queries)

name: estimate_property
title: Estimate a property's value (comparables)
description: Transparent comparables-based valuation of a flat or house at a precise French address: weighted median of nearby single-dwelling notarized sales, adjusted to current market level, with every comp and weight returned for audit. Also returns the official rent indicator and gross rental yield.

rooms.description: Main rooms (pièces principales) — refines the rent indicator

price_m2_adjusted.description: Comp price expressed at current market level

weight.description: Share of the heaviest comp's weight (1 = the heaviest)

typical_annual_charge_eur.description: Average charge per taxable article in the commune, not an individual tax bill

name: rent_estimate
title: Rent indicators (Carte des loyers)
description: Official modelled asking rents (€/m²/month, charges included) for any French commune: apartments overall, 1-2 rooms, 3+ rooms, and houses. Source: Carte des loyers, Ministère du Logement / ANIL.

location.description: Address, commune name or INSEE code

surface_m2.description: If given, also returns the estimated monthly rent

name: property_tax_estimate
title: Average property tax by commune (REI)
description: Returns the annual average charge per taxable REI article for taxe foncière on built properties, including published communal, intercommunal, syndicate, GEMAPI and TEOM components. It is an aggregate proxy, not an individual property's tax bill. Source: DGFiP REI via OFGL.

location.description: Address, commune name or INSEE code

year.description: REI tax year; defaults to the latest available year

typical_annual_charge_eur.description: Average charge per taxable article in the commune, not an individual tax bill

name: property_report
title: Full property due-diligence report
description: One call, full dossier for a French address: price-per-m² market stats, recent notarized sales, energy diagnostics (DPE), natural & technological risks, commune profile, official rent indicators and an aggregate taxe foncière proxy — plus a comparables-based valuation, gross yield and yield after average property tax when type_local and surface_m2 are provided. Ideal first call when a user asks about a specific property. Pass `addresses` (2 to 5) instead of `address` to dossier several neighbourhoods in one call; each report is isolated, so one bad address returns its own error without sinking the batch.

addresses.description: 2 to 5 addresses to dossier in one call, for comparing neighbourhoods (mutually exclusive with `address`)

format.description: Answer shape: 'json' (default, structured dossier) or 'markdown' (same dossier rendered as shareable Markdown)

content.description: Rendered Markdown dossier, present when format is 'markdown'

price_per_m2.description: Set only when the deed covers exactly one dwelling

price_m2_adjusted.description: Comp price expressed at current market level

weight.description: Share of the heaviest comp's weight (1 = the heaviest)

typical_annual_charge_eur.description: Average charge per taxable article in the commune, not an individual tax bill

ceiling_eur_m2_month.description: Loyer de référence majoré: a legal ceiling

idu.description: Unique cadastral id quoted on deeds, e.g. 69382000AB0062

contenance_m2.description: Cadastral taxed area of the whole parcel, land included — not habitable surface

type.description: U urban, AU to be urbanised, A agricultural, N natural

code_iris.description: 9-character INSEE IRIS code, commune code plus 4 digits

etiquette_dpe.description: Energy label, A best to G worst

energy_label.description: Normalized DPE label used for the ruling

rental_status.description: Legal status of a main-residence lease at this label; inconnu = label missing, not lettable

ban_date.description: First day a new lease is unlawful (ISO), null when none is dated

conso_kwh_year.description: Annual primary energy from the DPE figure

available.description: false means Géorisques could not be reached: the risk status is UNKNOWN, not risk-free

query.description: Present in the batch form: the shared profile applied to every address

input_address.description: The address as requested, so a client can map each report to its input

error.description: Why this address could not be dossied; the other reports are unaffected

reports.description: One entry per requested address, in order

name: dpe_lookup
title: Energy performance diagnostics (DPE)
description: Find official energy performance certificates (DPE: energy label A-G, GES label, surface, construction year) filed for a French address, with the legal rental status at each label (décret n° 2024-501) and an estimated annual energy cost. Source: ADEME open data.

dataset.description: DPE register: existing dwellings (dpe03existant), new dwellings (dpe02neuf), or both (default all)

energy_price_eur_kwh.description: Tariff assumption for the energy-cost estimate in €/kWh (default 0.2562)

etiquette_dpe.description: Energy label, A best to G worst

energy_label.description: Normalized DPE label used for the ruling

rental_status.description: Legal status of a main-residence lease at this label; inconnu = label missing, not lettable

ban_date.description: First day a new lease is unlawful (ISO), null when none is dated

conso_kwh_year.description: Annual primary energy from the DPE figure

name: natural_risks
title: Natural & technological risks (Géorisques)
description: Official risk report for a French address or point: flood, clay shrink-swell, radon, earthquake, industrial sites... Source: Géorisques (Ministère de la Transition écologique).

available.description: false means Géorisques could not be reached: the risk status is UNKNOWN, not risk-free

name: commune_info
title: Commune information
description: Population, postcodes, département, région, surface and center coordinates of a French commune, by name or INSEE code.

query.description: Commune name or 5-char INSEE code (e.g. 'Lyon' or '69123')

name: reverse_geocode
title: Reverse geocode
description: Find the nearest French address for GPS coordinates.

citycode.description: INSEE code, arrondissement level in Paris/Lyon/Marseille

name: backtest_estimator
title: Walk-forward backtest of the valuation model
description: Replay the comparable-sales estimator on the commune's own notarized sales: every historical sale is valued using only the sales recorded before it (no look-ahead, own deed excluded), then compared with the price actually paid. Returns MAPE, median and 90th-percentile absolute error, signed bias, P25–P75 range coverage and the same metrics by surface band and by year. Use it to say how reliable estimate_property is in this specific market.

address.description: Precise address (street or house number) in France

from_year.description: First sale year to evaluate (default: every year available)

max_points.description: Max sales evaluated, most recent first (default 250)

bias_pct.description: Signed mean error: > 0 means the model over-estimates

interval_coverage_pct.description: Share of prices inside the P25–P75 range

name: cadastral_parcel
title: Cadastral parcel at an address
description: Official cadastral parcel(s) containing an address: unique cadastral id (idu) quoted on deeds, section, number and the official contenance in m². The contenance is the taxed area of the whole parcel, land included — not the dwelling's habitable surface — and the cadastre never records ownership. Source: IGN / DGFiP via API Carto.

idu.description: Unique cadastral id quoted on deeds, e.g. 69382000AB0062

contenance_m2.description: Cadastral taxed area of the whole parcel, land included — not habitable surface

name: urbanism_zoning
title: Urbanism rules at an address (PLU)
description: Urbanism zoning and prescriptions applicable to an address, from the Géoportail de l'urbanisme: zoning area label and type (U urban, AU to be urbanised, A agricultural, N natural), the regulation document reference, and the surface / linear / point prescriptions (emplacements réservés, protected areas, alignments…). It states which rules apply, never whether a project is permitted. Source: GPU, DGALN / IGN.

type.description: U urban, AU to be urbanised, A agricultural, N natural

name: iris_lookup
title: IRIS neighbourhood of an address
description: Identify the IRIS — INSEE's infra-communal statistical unit, about 2 000 inhabitants — containing an address: 9-character IRIS code, name, type and commune. Join that code to INSEE's IRIS tables for population and Filosofi income. Boundaries from IGN ADMINEXPRESS; this layer carries identity only, no socio-demographic figures.

code_iris.description: 9-character INSEE IRIS code, commune code plus 4 digits

name: rent_control
title: Rent-control reference rents
description: Loyer de référence, loyer de référence majoré (the legal ceiling) and minoré, in €/m²/month, for a rent-controlled area — by number of rooms, construction period and furnished status. Covers only the areas whose authority publishes an open grid (Paris, Métropole de Lyon); the response states explicitly when an address is not covered instead of guessing. Sources: Ville de Paris, Métropole de Lyon.

ceiling_eur_m2_month.description: Loyer de référence majoré: a legal ceiling

name: compare_properties
title: Compare 2–5 addresses side by side
description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 French addresses in one call: current market level (€/m²), comparables valuation with confidence, asking rents, DPE with legal rental status (décret n° 2024-501) and estimated energy cost, plus row-index rankings (cheapest market, best yield). Each section degrades independently, like property_report. Source: DVF, Carte des loyers, ADEME — official open data.

type_local.description: Enables the valuation row; filter by dwelling type

surface_m2.description: Enables the valuation and gross-yield rows

targets.description: 2 to 5 addresses to compare, in your order

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters around the address (default 500; ignored for city-wide queries)

valuation.description: Null when type_local or surface_m2 was not provided for this row

cheapest_eur_m2.description: Row indices, cheapest market median first

best_gross_yield_pct.description: Row indices, best valuation yield first

name: acquisition_costs
title: Acquisition costs and yield simulation
description: Simulate the costs of buying a French dwelling and its rental yield: droits de mutation (official 2026 scale, about 6.42 % for communes over 5 000 inhabitants), notary fees and publication, commune-average taxe foncière (REI), modelled asking rent (Carte des loyers), and gross / net yields. The price defaults to a comparables-based estimate (estimate_property) but can be replaced by an agreed or asking price. All figures are indicative — the taxe foncière is a commune average, never an individual tax notice, and rents are modelled asking rents, not regulated reference rents. Source: DVF, Carte des loyers, REI.

price_eur.description: Known price in € (negotiated or asking). Absent: use the comparables-based estimate.

price_from.description: What price_eur means when provided; 'estimate' (default) lets the tool value the dwelling itself

notary_model.description: Notary fee assumption: standard (typical card), hands_off (about +250 €), aggressive (bare minimum, 750 €)

taxe_foncière_annuale.description: Commune-average annual taxe foncière from the REI dataset — not an individual tax notice

net_yield_pct.description: After the average property tax and the acquisition fees

name: search_by_budget
title: Find what a budget can buy in a zone
description: The inverse of the estimator: 'with 300 k€, where can I buy?' For each commune of a département it computes the median €/m² from actual notarized sales (DVF, last 4 published years), divides the budget by it to get the surface the budget buys, and layers the modelled asking rent for the gross yield. Returns the qualifying communes ranked by surface, yield and price, plus the communes skipped for lack of data. The budget is the purchase price only — acquisition fees come on top (see acquisition_costs). Source: DVF, Carte des loyers, geo.api.gouv.fr.

type_local.description: Dwelling type; absent: all single-dwelling sales

zone.description: Commune name, INSEE code, address, or département code (e.g. '69', '13')

min_surface_m2.description: Minimum surface the budget must buy (default 30)

max_communes.description: Communes to scan, most populous first (default 15, max 40)

most_surface.description: Indices into communes, most surface per euro first

name: risk_summary
title: Risk summary: one line per risk
description: Consumer-grade risk digest for a French address or point: one plain-language sentence each for flood, clay shrink-swell, radon, industrial sites (ICPE) and the DPE rental-ban schedule, plus a one-line headline and any other present risk named. Reuses Géorisques and ADEME. When Géorisques is unreachable every risk line reads UNKNOWN — never a clean bill of health. Source: Géorisques, ADEME.

available.description: false: Géorisques unreachable, so every risk status is UNKNOWN, not risk-free

headline.description: One-sentence synthesis; states UNKNOWN explicitly when the source is down

signals_count.description: Items reading `present`: a risk signalled, or a rental ban that applies

status.description: unknown = source unreachable or DPE missing/unreadable, never "safe"

sentence.description: One plain-language line a client can render as-is

other_present_risks.description: Present risks outside the summarised categories, named so nothing is hidden
